metaData.title: Morning Briefing: Apple WWDC Limited Edition Gifts Revealed / ByteDance: No Car Manufacturing Plans / Google Pays SpaceX $920 Million Monthly for Computing Power
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: The ifanr morning briefing summarizes over 20 tech and consumer news items, including Apple's AI strategy overhaul for WWDC 2026, ByteDance denying car manufacturing plans, Google paying SpaceX $920 million monthly for computing power, and features an in-depth perspective from a psychologist on outsourcing cognitive work to AI.
metaData.summary: This article is the ifanr tech morning briefing for June 8, covering over 20 short news items and in-depth reports. Core content includes: Bloomberg's Gurman reveals Apple spent two years rebuilding its AI strategy, from 'AIMLess' to a major WWDC overhaul, with Mike Rockwell taking over Siri and a partnership with Google on Gemini and cloud infrastructure; ifanr has arrived at Apple Park and showcases geeky Easter eggs in the WWDC gift bags; ByteDance clarifies it has no car manufacturing plans; reports that OpenAI is merging Codex entirely into ChatGPT; Google pays SpaceX $920 million monthly to lease approximately 110,000 GPUs as a short-term bridging agreement; NVIDIA and SK hynix reach a multi-year partnership to develop next-generation memory for AI factories; Honda's sales in China have nearly halved for two consecutive months; Qualcomm's automotive business achieved $1.3 billion in quarterly revenue and released multiple cockpit-driving integration chips; JD.com and Tencent are reportedly set to collaborate around AI Agents; the world's first prefabricated computing power center base was put into operation in Qingdao; Origin Quantum completed a nearly 3 billion yuan Pre-IPO round. Additionally, MIT Technology Review reports psychologist Gloria Mark stating that outsourcing cognitive work to AI leads to 'losing control of your brain,' suggesting a re-evaluation of our relationship with AI. Other briefs cover the Xiaomi 17T series launch, Jianan smart glasses, Dongfeng unmanned logistics vehicles, Honda HRC developing a more hardcore Civic Type R, OpenCV 5 release, Luckin Coffee responding to 'no ice, not full cup' complaints, Seesaw filing for bankruptcy liquidation, Taylor Swift's song breaking records in 'Toy Story 5', and an AI origin documentary screening.

mainPoints.point: Apple spent two years rebuilding its AI strategy, from 'AIMLess' to a major WWDC overhaul.
mainPoints.explanation: After the failure of Apple Intelligence 1.0, Apple's top management initiated a restructuring in early 2025. Vision Pro founder Mike Rockwell took over Siri, and a partnership with Google on Gemini and cloud infrastructure was reached, with plans to launch a standalone AI assistant app.

mainPoints.point: Google pays SpaceX $920 million monthly to lease approximately 110,000 GPUs as a short-term bridging agreement.
mainPoints.explanation: This agreement runs from October 2026 to June 2029, intended to meet customer demand for Gemini Enterprise and its agent platform that exceeded expectations, and includes exit clauses.

mainPoints.point: Psychologists warn that outsourcing cognitive work to AI can weaken deep processing abilities.
mainPoints.explanation: Psychologist Gloria Mark from UC Irvine points out that when people delegate writing, summarizing, and evaluating to AI, they lose the opportunity to learn, understand, and remember. She suggests retraining attention, memory, and emotional abilities.

mainPoints.point: Qualcomm's automotive business achieved $1.3 billion in quarterly revenue, with cockpit-driving integration chips covering vehicles priced from 100,000 yuan to over 300,000 yuan.
mainPoints.explanation: Qualcomm released three chips—Snapdragon 8775, 8397, and 8797—targeting different price segments. The 8797 offers a single-chip computing power of 1280 TOPS and has secured design wins for 18 vehicle models.

mainPoints.point: Honda's sales in China have nearly halved for two consecutive months, dropping 48.68% year-on-year in May.
mainPoints.explanation: Honda sold fewer than 30,000 vehicles in May, while several Chinese new energy vehicle manufacturers delivered over 30,000 units each during the same period. GAC Honda plans to launch new models based on a China-exclusive platform starting in 2027.

keyQuotes: Outsourcing cognitive work to AI leads to 'losing control of your brain.'
Effort itself brings a deeper sense of satisfaction; these examples are also a retraining of attention, memory, and emotional abilities.

relatedArticles.title: Tech Enthusiast Weekly (Issue 399): Notes on Visiting China's AI Giants
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article excerpts the impressions of a US tech analyst after visiting 14 Chinese AI companies, covering 11 dimensions including computing power gap, computational efficiency, open-source divergence, talent structure, and attitudes toward AI safety, presenting a realistic view of China's AI industry.

relatedArticles.title: Dowson Tong and Yao Shunyu in Conversation: Tencent AI's Second Half
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Dowson Tong, Senior Executive Vice President of Tencent Group, and Yao Shunyu, Chief AI Scientist, engaged in a joint dialogue centered on the core propositions of AI's second half—shifting from 'solving problems' to 'defining problems,' Co-Design of models and products, the evolution and cost-effectiveness of Agent technology, and Tencent's strategic pace and organizational transformation in the AI era—offering a deep conversation blending strategic vision with engineering practice.

relatedArticles.title: "The Water is Drying Up, Fish Need to Evolve": Revisiting Yuandong Tian, RSI at a $4.65 Billion Valuation and AI Self-Evolution | Neolabs Special
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: An in-depth interview with Yuandong Tian, detailing his decision to join RSI, the technical roadmap for recursive self-improvement and its commercialization, and exploring career shifts and personal meaning in the AI era.

relatedArticles.title: iPhone Finally Gets Siri AI! But Mainland China Misses Out on the First Release, Alarm Clock Becomes the Biggest Surprise
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: WWDC26 unveils iOS 27 and new Apple Intelligence developments, upgrading Siri to a system-level AI assistant with its own app, but users in mainland China will temporarily miss out on the AI features.

relatedArticles.title: A Comprehensive Guide to Microsoft Build 2026: The 'Agent-First' Era Arrives with Seven In-House Models
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Microsoft Build 2026 unveiled seven in-house MAI models, the Scout agent, the MXC system-level security sandbox, and Project Solara, marking the full implementation of an 'Agent-First' strategy.

relatedArticles.title: Elon Musk weighs in! Kimi's paper challenges the 'ancestral foundation' of large models
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has released the 'Attention Residuals' technical report. By introducing attention mechanisms into deep residual connections, it challenges and reconstructs the underlying architecture that large models have relied on for a decade, significantly improving training efficiency.

relatedArticles.title: Musk Spent $10 Billion to Figure Out One Thing: Not Building a Coding Agent Is a Death Sentence
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article thoroughly argues the core point that model providers must build their own coding agent products to obtain high-quality process supervision data and drive continuous model evolution, while analyzing the data game logic behind the $10 billion partnership between SpaceX and Cursor.

relatedArticles.title: The Most Worthwhile Productivity Upgrade This Year Might Be an Entire AI-Powered Workspace
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on real workflows, this article recommends AI tools like Gemini, Kimi, Feishu, Obsidian, Plaud, GPT-Image-2, TapNow, and Claude Code, emphasizing that the core of a workspace upgrade is optimizing the human-AI collaboration, not just piling on tools.

relatedArticles.title: Dialogue with MiniMax's Zeyin: Agents Will Eventually Surpass Humans, Where Do We Go From Here?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Through an in-depth conversation with Zeyin, a MiniMax Agent R&D engineer, this article reveals the design philosophy and technical details of the Agent Team architecture, as well as the industry consensus and trend shifting from model competition to scaffolding competition in Agent engineering.

relatedArticles.title: "The Biggest IPO in Human History": Is SpaceX More Than Just Rockets?
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Based on SpaceX's prospectus, this article analyzes its $45 billion computing contract with Anthropic, its holdings of 18,712 Bitcoin, its board composition and aggressive governance structure, and the critical significance of the V3 Starship test flight for its valuation.
